title: Reso Tech Laurentides
description: resotechlaurentides.com Reso & Tech Laurentides is a Canadian industrial engineering company founded in 2001 in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, specializing in the design and manufacture of specialized machinery, automation systems and robotic cells for automotive, aerospace, pharmaceutical and food industries. With approximately 150 employees and over 1,500 completed projects exported to more than 20 countries, it offers full-cycle services from concept design through manufacturing, commissioning and maintenance. Its capabilities span PLC and SCADA automation, industrial robotics, machine vision, test systems and custom assembly lines. The company operates from its main facility in Saint-Jérôme with commercial offices in Laval and Toronto. Revenue is estimated at 30 to 50 million dollars. Its automotive clients include major North American manufacturers while its aerospace and pharmaceutical projects demand precision engineering and sterile environments.
